_comment: GROUND TRUTH - ORBIN CONTRACTING LLC package (EMC Insurance, policy term 07/15/25-07/15/26).
Built by reading the real declarations pages, not by running the pipeline. Used by
backend/scripts/score_gap_fill.py to put a correctness number on LLM call 2.
Every value below is quoted from a DECLARATIONS or SCHEDULE page, with the page noted.
Nothing here is inferred from policy wording - that is the whole point.
PACKAGE COMPOSITION, all 271 pages: 30 declarations/schedule pages, 241 ISO+AAIS
standard form pages. 11% signal, 89% boilerplate. Per part: 17% / 9% / 8% - the
ratio gets WORSE as the package goes on, because every added coverage part brings
one dec page and dozens of wording pages. This is the haystack, measured.
FIVE coverage parts: Inland Marine (6C7-40-02), Business Auto (6E7-40-02),
Commercial Umbrella (6J7-40-02), General Liability (BBC7263), plus the Common
Declarations. Property, Crime and Workers Comp are all 'No Coverage'.
_traps below is not scored - it records the specific boilerplate sentences in THIS
document that have already produced client-reported wrong values, so a regression on
any of them is recognised instantly rather than re-diagnosed from scratch.

estimated_total_premium.reconciliation: 3954 (GL) + 300 (IM) + 2991 (Auto) + 3418 (Umbrella) = 10,663 EXACTLY. Every line is now confirmed on its own section declarations page: GL p205, IM p3, Auto p85, Umbrella p143. `_reconcile_total_premium` prefers an exact-sum match and now has one, and its validity floor (a total may not be at or below the largest single granted line, $3,954) rejects $2,991 outright.

decoys.$2,991.00: page 85 - the AUTO SECTION subtotal, printed as '*ESTIMATED TOTAL POLICY PREMIUM'. Identical label to the package total. This is the C46 defect's exact source.
decoys.$3,954.00: pages 1, 205, 211 - the GL premium, and the largest single granted line. Printed THREE times against the true total's ONE.
decoys.$3,418.00: page 143 - Umbrella, 'PREMIUM NOT SUBJECT TO AUDIT'

decoys.your members or managers if you are a li: pages 36 and 51, IM7000 / IM7100 exclusion boilerplate. Ticks the CORRECT box for the WRONG reason - so a passing result here can still be luck. Check the grounding quote, not just the value.

gl_limits.source: page 205, GENERAL LIABILITY DECLARATIONS (Form CG7000A), EMC Property & Casualty Company, Policy BBC7263-26. Independently confirmed on page 148, the Umbrella's SCHEDULE OF UNDERLYING INSURANCE - the two agree exactly.

decoys.$3,000,000: page 143, COMMERCIAL UMBRELLA DECLARATIONS - the UMBRELLA's own limits, printed as three clean lines: 'Each Occurrence Limit (Liability Coverage)', 'Personal & Advertising Injury Limit', 'Aggregate Limit (Liability Coverage)'.

gl_limits.note: THE C23 DEFECT'S SOURCE, located, and part 3 makes it worse rather than better. There are now TWO pages titled DECLARATIONS carrying different 'Each Occurrence' limits - page 143 says $3,000,000 (umbrella) and page 205 says $1,000,000 (GL) - SIXTY-TWO PAGES APART. Nothing in the text distinguishes them except which coverage part's dec page you are standing on. That is page identity, and page identity is exactly what a single 175k-token prompt destroys. Chunking restores it.

gl_premium.source: page 205, and again on page 211 (GENERAL LIABILITY SCHEDULE)

Contrctrs-sub work-in connection w/constrctn,recon,repr,erctn of buildings - NOC

gl_class_codes.source: page 211, GENERAL LIABILITY SCHEDULE (Form CG7001A), Location 001
gl_class_codes.note: THE C46 PHANTOM-VEHICLE-ROW DEFECT'S LITERAL SOURCE. CLAUDE.md records ACORD 127 rows 2-3 coming back with 'the General Liability class codes 91580/91585 and the GL exposures ($39,300 payroll, $350,000 subcontract cost) stamped as vehicle COST NEW.' All four values are on this single page. There is ONE vehicle in this package and it is a 2012 Subaru Outback costing $26,680 - these numbers have nothing to do with it. A vehicle-schedule question that reaches this page in an undifferentiated blob will find four numbers shaped exactly like the answer.

operations.note: Printed TRUNCATED as 'COMMERCIAL GENERAL CONTRA' on every dec page (pages 3, 85, 143) - the carrier's field is too narrow. The GL class-code descriptions on page 211 are the fuller statement of what the business actually does: executive supervision plus subcontracted construction, reconstruction, repair and erection of buildings.
operations.rated_location: 4800 Dahlia St # D13, Denver, CO 80216-3121 (page 212, 'Location of All Premises Owned, Rented or Occupied' - ONE location, 'Location 1')

gl_deductible.reason: There is NO general GL deductible on this policy. The GL declarations page (205) lists limits only.

decoys.$1,000: page 207, CG 72 76 Limited Pollution Coverage - Work Sites: 'Property Damage Deductible $1,000 Each Pollution Incidents'. That is a POLLUTION deductible inside one endorsement, not the policy's GL deductible. It is the likely source of the '$1,000 GL deductible' in the umbrella_sir_below_gl_deductible false positive already deleted on 2026-08-12.

umbrella.note: SIR is $0 against a $1,000 Auto comp/collision deductible. That pairing is the false-positive warning already fixed on 2026-08-07 - this package is its literal reproduction case, so a re-run must stay silent on it.

driver_schedule.reason: There is NO driver schedule in this package. No licence numbers, no dates of birth, no driver rows.

decoys.ERIN ROYAL: page 92, CA 99 10 A DRIVE OTHER CAR COVERAGE, under 'NAMES OF INDIVIDUALS'. The ONLY personal name in 180 pages, and it is a Drive Other Car named individual, NOT a driver on the vehicle schedule. This is the source of the C22 defect where 'ERIN ROYAL' landed in Driver_TaxIdentifier_A and Driver_GenderCode_A.

_repeated_boilerplate.note: A MERGE defect, not a retrieval one - chunking will not fix it. Common interline forms attach to EVERY coverage part, so their text repeats once per part while a real declarations value is printed ONCE. `_merge_list_fields` ranks candidates on log1p(freq) + confidence, so the bias scales with the number of coverage parts. This package has five. CONFIRMED COUNTS across all 271 pages:
_repeated_boilerplate.the_arithmetic: log1p(1) = 0.693 for the $10,663 total premium, printed once. log1p(4) = 1.609 for the IL0017 boilerplate. The boilerplate scores 2.3x the real number on frequency alone, before confidence is even considered.
_repeated_boilerplate.recommendation: Worth its own fix after the harness produces a baseline. Options include damping frequency for text that appears in a known standard form, or scoring dec-page provenance rather than raw repetition. Do not touch it before there is a number to move.

_blank_form_trap.form: CA 8282 COLORADO BODILY INJURY UNINSURED MOTORISTS COVERAGE SELECTION/REJECTION
_blank_form_trap.note: An UNCOMPLETED form. 'Producer:', 'Insured Name and Mailing Address:', 'Effective Date', 'Policy/Account Number', '(Initials)' and four signature lines are all EMPTY. It also prints '$50,000' as the Colorado statutory minimum UM limit. Two risks: the model reading empty labelled boxes as data, and $50,000 being taken for this policy's UM limit. The real UM limit is $1,000,000 (page 88).

_auto_section_pages_85_90.note: Not scored on ACORD 125 - recorded for the 127 fixture and to pin the vehicle-schedule retrieval case.
_auto_section_pages_85_90.phantom_row_check: ONE vehicle only. Rows B-N of ACORD 127 must stay blank. This is the C46 phantom-schedule-row case with real data.
